title: prangos sarawschanica
intro: Prangos sarawschanica, commonly known as the Mongolian Angelica, is a plant species in the carrot family Apiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Prangos sarawschanica include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer activities. The plant's extracts have been studied for their potential to treat various health conditions, including cardiovascular diseases, cancer, and neurodegenerative disorders.
